title: Gaussian log-density and maximum likelihood
summary: Compute the Gaussian log-density without underflow, fit the mean and standard deviation by maximum likelihood, and score data with the log-likelihood.

mutants.log_of_pdf: Computes the density first and then takes its log, so a point far in the tail gives minus infinity.
mutants.sample_std: Fits the standard deviation with ddof=1, which is not the maximum likelihood estimate.
mutants.missing_half: Uses log(2 pi sigma^2) without the factor 1/2 in the normalizing constant.
mutants.mean_not_sum: Averages the log-densities and does not sum them in log_likelihood.
mutants.returns_variance: Returns the variance, and not the standard deviation, from fit_gaussian.
